defects.title: No session guard: every buyer page is served to anonymous visitors
defects.expected: Unauthenticated requests to amazon.html, checkout.html, orders.html, user_details.html, payments.html and tracking.html are redirected to login.html.
defects.actual: All six pages render their full content without any login; no session token is created at login time either.
defects.repro: Open http://127.0.0.1:5501/checkout.html directly in a fresh browser profile.
defects.rootCause: login.html never persists an authenticated session and no page performs an access check.

defects.title: Card number is written into the URL by a GET form submission
defects.expected: Payment data is never exposed in the address bar, browser history or Referer header.
defects.actual: payments.html submits through GET with named inputs, producing ?card-number=4111111111111112&expiration-date=...&cvv=...
defects.repro: Submit a valid card on payments.html and inspect the address bar after the success alert.
defects.rootCause: The Proceed control is a bare submit button inside a form with no method/action and no preventDefault.

defects.title: Hard-coded credentials shipped in client-side source
defects.expected: Credential verification happens server side; no secret appears in page source.
defects.actual: login.html contains both valid username/password pairs in an inline script.
defects.repro: View source of login.html and search for the password strings.
defects.rootCause: Authentication implemented entirely in the browser for the assignment demo.

defects.title: Credential policy violated: numeric-only password accepted
defects.expected: Per REQ-09.3 the password must be at least 8 characters with mixed character classes.
defects.actual: The account 'Yogesh' authenticates with the 10-digit phone number 8329097855.
defects.repro: Log in with Yogesh / 8329097855.
defects.rootCause: No password policy is enforced anywhere in the application.

defects.title: Expiry date validation accepts impossible and past dates
defects.expected: Months 01-12 only, and any date earlier than the current month must be refused.
defects.actual: The expression /^\d{2}\/\d{2}$/ accepts 13/25, 99/99 and 01/20.
defects.repro: Enter expiry 13/25 (or 99/99, or 01/20) with a valid card and CVV, then press Proceed.
defects.rootCause: isValidExpirationDate in payments.html only checks the shape of the string.

defects.title: Login failure message blames the wrong field
defects.expected: An unknown username must be reported as a username problem.
defects.actual: An unknown username with the password '5555' is reported as 'Invalid Password'.
defects.repro: Submit username 'nobody' with password '5555'.
defects.rootCause: login.html tests the password branch before the username branch.

defects.title: Zipcode accepts any character and any length
defects.expected: Zipcode is constrained to 5-10 numeric characters.
defects.actual: 'ABCDE', '90' and a 12-digit string are all accepted as a valid address.
defects.repro: Fill the address form with zipcode 'ABCDE' and press Next.
defects.rootCause: user_details.html only checks that the field is non-empty.

defects.title: Card number accepts any 16 digits (no checksum)
defects.expected: A card that fails the Luhn checksum is refused.
defects.actual: 0000000000000000 is accepted as a successful payment.
defects.repro: Pay with card 0000000000000000, expiry 12/28, CVV 123.
defects.rootCause: isValidCardNumber in payments.html only tests /^\d{16}$/.

defects.title: Hard-coded host and port in an onclick handler
defects.expected: All navigation is origin relative so the app can be served from any host or port.
defects.actual: orders.html line 176 navigates to http://127.0.0.1:5501/user_details.html.
defects.repro: Serve the app on any port other than 5501 and press 'Buy it again' on the third order.
defects.rootCause: Absolute URL literal inside the inline onclick attribute.

defects.title: Header search is disabled and unimplemented
defects.expected: The search button is enabled and filters the catalogue by the entered query.
defects.actual: The button carries the disabled attribute and no filtering code exists.
defects.repro: Open amazon.html, type 'basketball' and try to search.
defects.rootCause: amazon.html renders <button disabled class="search-button"> and scripts/amazon.js has no search handler.

defects.title: Successful form submissions dead-end instead of advancing the flow
defects.expected: Address step routes to payments.html; payment routes to an order confirmation.
defects.actual: Both steps only alert and then perform a native GET reload of the same page.
defects.repro: Complete user_details.html or payments.html and watch the address bar.
defects.rootCause: The Proceed controls are submit buttons with no preventDefault and no navigation logic.

defects.title: Quantity selector is ignored when adding to cart
defects.expected: Choosing quantity 5 adds five units to the cart.
defects.actual: Exactly one unit is added regardless of the selected quantity.
defects.repro: On amazon.html select quantity 5 on any product and press Add to Cart.
defects.rootCause: scripts/amazon.js reads only data-product-id and never the adjacent <select>.

defects.title: Product detail pages load a script that does not exist (HTTP 404)
defects.expected: products/backpack.html and products/basketball.html wire their Add to Cart / Buy Now buttons.
defects.actual: Both pages request ../scripts/product-details.js which the server answers with 404, so the buttons are inert.
defects.repro: Open products/backpack.html, press Add to Cart, and check the cart counter.
defects.rootCause: Missing asset: scripts/product-details.js was never committed.

defects.title: Checkout header cart counter is never synchronised
defects.expected: The header counter shows the live cart quantity on checkout.html and updates after deletions.
defects.actual: The counter keeps the hard-coded 0 for the whole session on that page.
defects.repro: Open checkout.html with a non-empty cart, then delete a line.
defects.rootCause: scripts/checkout.js never touches .js-cart-quantity.

defects.title: Delivery option radios have no effect
defects.expected: Selecting a delivery option updates the displayed delivery date and the shipping charge.
defects.actual: The radios have no change handler; the line keeps 'Tuesday, June 21'.
defects.repro: On checkout.html select the third delivery option.
defects.rootCause: scripts/checkout.js renders the radios but binds no listener.

defects.title: Order summary panel is static markup
defects.expected: Item count and amounts are computed from the live cart.
defects.actual: The panel always shows Items (3) / $42.75 / $52.51 regardless of cart content.
defects.repro: Delete a cart line or add a product, then re-open checkout.html.
defects.rootCause: checkout.html hard-codes the summary rows; only the line list is dynamic.

defects.title: Buy-it-again buttons are inert or misrouted
defects.expected: Pressing Buy it again returns that product to the cart.
defects.actual: #product-1 and #product-2 have no handler; #product-3 navigates to the address form.
defects.repro: On orders.html press any Buy it again button and inspect the cart.
defects.rootCause: orders.html defines the buttons without behaviour (except one onclick literal).

defects.title: Tracking page hard-codes the cart counter
defects.expected: The header counter reflects the real cart size on every page.
defects.actual:
tracking.html renders
3
with no js- hook, so it always shows 3.
defects.repro: Seed a one-item cart and open tracking.html.
defects.rootCause: tracking.html omits the js-cart-quantity class used by the header script.

defects.title: Catalogue header cart counter is not synchronised on page load
defects.expected: Opening amazon.html with items already in the cart shows the live unit count in the header counter.
defects.actual: The header keeps the hard-coded 0 for a returning buyer until an Add to Cart click runs; a seeded 3-unit cart still displays 0 after a reload.
defects.repro: Seed the cart with 3 units in localStorage, open amazon.html, and read the header counter before clicking anything.
defects.rootCause: scripts/amazon.js calls updateCartQuantity() only inside the add-to-cart click handler (line 80) and never on initial render, while amazon.html hard-codes .js-cart-quantity to 0.

defects.title: Shipping charge contradicts the selected delivery option
defects.expected: The summary charges the price of the pre-selected delivery option (FREE by default).
defects.actual: The summary always charges $4.99 while the default radio is FREE Shipping.
defects.repro: Open checkout.html and compare the first delivery option with the shipping row.
defects.rootCause: Static summary markup plus unbound delivery radios.

defects.title: Login page logo anchor is not keyboard reachable
defects.expected: Interactive anchors expose an href so keyboard users can reach them.
defects.actual: login.html renders <a id="header-link"> without href.
defects.repro: Tab through login.html and try to activate the logo.
defects.rootCause: Anchor used as a click target without a destination.

defects.title: Empty cart renders a blank review page
defects.expected: An empty cart shows an explanatory message and a link back to the catalogue.
defects.actual: The order summary area renders nothing at all.
defects.repro: Delete every cart line and reload checkout.html.
defects.rootCause: scripts/checkout.js concatenates zero line templates and writes an empty string.

exploratory.observation: Five rapid Add-to-Cart clicks on the same product left the header counter at "8" (expected 5). Cart writes are unthrottled local-array updates, so bursts can drop or double-count increments.

exploratory.charter: Explore the complete customer checkout and payment journey using edge-case inputs, rapid multi-clicks and browser history transitions (SFDIPOT / extreme-value tour, 45 min timebox).
exploratory.observation: With zero items in the cart the "Place your order" button is still clickable and the buyer is routed to the address step instead of the action being disabled. An empty order can advance through checkout.

exploratory.charter: Explore the complete customer checkout and payment journey using edge-case inputs, rapid multi-clicks and browser history transitions (SFDIPOT / extreme-value tour, 45 min timebox).
exploratory.observation: From payments.html the back button landed on "http://127.0.0.1:5501/checkout.html" and forward returned to "http://127.0.0.1:5501/payments.html". The payment form re-renders from the query string, so card data typed on the first visit is either replayed from the URL or silently cleared depending on direction.

exploratory.observation: The zipcode field accepted "-@@12" and the form reported "User details entered successfully!". Only blankness is checked; there is no numeric/format validation on the postal code.

exploratory.charter: Tour the data-entry and access-control surfaces with hostile and out-of-range inputs (SFDIPOT data/interface tour): address fields, direct URL access to protected pages, and reflected input.
exploratory.observation: Injecting an onerror image payload into the address field did not execute script (input is treated as text). Recorded as an observation for the security taxonomy.

exploratory.charter: Tour the data-entry and access-control surfaces with hostile and out-of-range inputs (SFDIPOT data/interface tour): address fields, direct URL access to protected pages, and reflected input.
exploratory.observation: Requesting checkout.html directly in an unauthenticated session stayed on "http://127.0.0.1:5501/checkout.html" — the page is reachable without authentication (client-side-only protection).

exploratory.charter: Tour the data-entry and access-control surfaces with hostile and out-of-range inputs (SFDIPOT data/interface tour): address fields, direct URL access to protected pages, and reflected input.
exploratory.observation: Hand-editing localStorage to quantity 99 and reloading produced 1 cart line(s) with summary "(none)". Cart state is fully client-trusted; quantities can be inflated without any server reconciliation.
